decision: Research-only fatal economic screen. No paper, testnet, or live orders.

information_boundary.event_clock: Tardis local_timestamp capture order in UTC
information_boundary.signal_data: Completed liquidation event minute; reversal also waits for one completed confirmation minute
information_boundary.entry: Next one-minute contract open after the decision minute
information_boundary.tie_break: Original CSV row order after local_timestamp
information_boundary.known_source_limitation: Binance forceOrder became a maximum one-order-per-second snapshot stream on 2021-04-27; observed liquidation flow is a lower bound, never reconstructed as full flow.

account.unresolved_position_treatment: No forced exit. Candidate is penalized and cannot pass if any selected trade is unresolved inside the downloaded price path.

promotion_boundary: A public first-day-monthly sample can only establish event-study discovery. It cannot certify the 2024-2026 full-calendar target or replace a Bybit-native replication with complete liquidation and execution data.
